item.title: 10 Perfectly Designed Final Fantasy Magic Cards That Are 10/10, No Notes
item.description: Packed with hilarious nods, like Suplex , and incredible powerhouses, like Diamond Weapon , it comes as no surprise that Final Fantasy is among the best Universe Beyond sets in the game. But the most perfect designs among them capture a fundamental element of their source material, whether that's Bahamut 's devastating Mega Flare, Phoenix Down' s clutch resurrection, or the sheer spectacle of summoning Primal Odin .

item.title: Paramount’s 4-Part Action Fantasy Epic Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History
item.description: Few things feel more grown-up than dealing with the consequences of your actions. Whether you stay up too late and still have to get up the next day or make a mistake at work and have to answer for it, adulthood means no one’s coming to fix things. For the most part, it’s all up to you.

item.title: 9 Near-Perfect Dragon Age Replacements For Fans of Fantasy RPGs
item.description: BioWare’s Dragon Age is a fantasy RPG series about warring factions, world-ending threats, and, yes, the occasional dragon – but that’s the first-glance take. Get into one Dragon Age game ( start with Origins ! ) and you’ll see that the true heart of this series is the people you drag into hell with you.

item.title: How to Play Every GTA Game in 2026
item.description: Rockstar Games seems to have an ambivalent attitude towards GTA's past, particularly the early 2D games and some spinoff titles, and its record in making these games available is decidedly spotty. Below, we break down the current state of availability of every game in the series — where you can find it, and what the best way to play it is.

item.title: 8 Near-Perfect BioWare Games That Aged Like Fine Wine
item.description: A pack of wolves can end a Baldur’s Gate 1 playthrough a mere five minutes after the tutorial ends. A squadmate you didn’t bother checking in on in Mass Effect 2 can die permanently during a mission you don’t get to redo. And a Sonic RPG on the Nintendo DS can end its story with the good guys saving the universe…then coming home to find someone named Eggman conquered Earth while they were gone. Most people know BioWare as the Mass Effect studio, which is incredible on its own — but that undersells the vast range that built the studio’s reputation in the first place.

item.title: 4 Years Later, Captain Pike's Most Inspiring Star Trek Quote Is Still the Best Sci-Fi Line of the Decade
item.description: For most of Star Trek's existence, Christopher Pike was little more than a footnote in franchise history. He was the captain of the Enterprise before James T. Kirk , a character whose greatest claim to fame was appearing in a rejected television pilot. Then Anson Mount came along and changed everything.

item.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Meets Papers, Please in Steam’s Latest Surprise Viral Hit
item.description: Every now and then, a game with little to no fanfare pre-launch gets blessed by the algorithm and surges in popularity. Probably Stolen is the latest recipient of this; after being released on Oct. 28, it's continued to climb in popularity, peaking at 174,382 concurrent players on Nov. 4, according to SteamDB .

item.title: Fortune treasure hours schedule in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Fortnite is continuing the tradition of special Saturday hourly events during the Chapter 7 mini season , though this time they're treasure hours , centered around the pirate-themed "Treasure Hunters" season. During these hours, certain sprites will get increased drop rates, and you'll drop into the game with special items.

item.title: All Gold Skulltula locations in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Gold Skulltulas act as a collectible in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, but they're also needed to cure a cursed family in Kakariko Village.

item.title: 5 Incredible Anime Arcs That Are 10/10, No Notes
item.description: Consider the Chimera Ant arc from Hunter x Hunter , which is nothing short of a rite of passage . It pushes the anime’s deconstruction of shonen conventions to its limits while sending Gon Freecss and Killua Zoldyck down starkly different paths. The Shibuya Incident arc from Jujutsu Kaisen is similarly transformative, shattering the established order of jujutsu society through its intersecting perspectives, major character deaths, and relentless succession of battles.
